select.if: SELECT DISTINCT TB.TABLE_NAME AS tableName, COL.COLUMN_NAME AS columnName, COL.COLUMN_TYPE AS dataType, COL.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS dataLength, COL.IS_NULLABLE AS nullable, COL.ORDINAL_POSITION AS columnId FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES TB, INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS COL WHERE TB.TABLE_SCHEMA = 'zoutest' AND TB.TABLE_NAME = '${table}' AND TB.TABLE_NAME = COL.TABLE_NAME

SELECT TABLE_NAME as tableName, COLUMN_NAME as columnName, DATA_TYPE as dataType, DATA_LENGTH as dataLength, NULLABLE as nullable, COLUMN_ID as columnId FROM USER_TAB_COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = '${table}' ORDER BY COLUMN_ID
